Read read_audit_task and keep each assigned item_key.
Use the pinned engagement and only its permitted target operations; retain actual captures without replay.

During work call evidence with common sources, interpretation, tested_conditions
and limitations. Inspect its Server persistence receipt. Grounds and source reads
do not automatically register check evidence. Publish evidenced problems through
the selected finding tool when available, including incidental discoveries.
Inspect publication receipts before final submission.

Use submit_result(item_key, rationale, limitations, optional verdict) or
submit_results with every assigned key once. Supply supported, refuted or
inconclusive only for a hypothesis; exploration omits verdict. Runtime assembles
the accepted exact evidence and condition notes. A conclusive judgment needs
selected evidence and conditions; inconclusive needs a limitation. Correct one
item in a later scalar call before sealing. Do not supply revision counters,
identities, final evidence inventories or a structured result package.
